story.name: map
story.title: Map
story.definition: Measured kernel control over fixed public operations.
story.design_decl: comb @map[f: C * A -> B](ctx: C, xs: List<A>) -> List<B> = @jump[lambda pair -> Pair<tail(pair.first),append(pair.second,f(ctx,head(pair.first)))>,lambda pair -> not(empty(pair.first))](Pair<xs,List<>>,len(xs)).second L1
story.decl: comb @map[f: A -> A](p: A, xs: A) -> A = rec walk(remaining, output) = if empty(remaining) then output else walk(tail(remaining), append(output, f(p, head(remaining)))) measure length(remaining) in walk(xs, List<>) L1

contract.guarantees: Finite, unfolded public operations and exact kernel costs.

story.name: until
story.title: Until
story.definition: Measured kernel control over fixed public operations.
story.design_decl: comb @until[step: A -> A, measure: A -> Nat](x: A) -> A = let c=Pair<x,step(x)> in @jump[lambda pair -> Pair<pair.second,step(pair.second)>,lambda pair -> if eq(pair.first,pair.second) then false else if le(measure(pair.first),measure(pair.second)) then Bottom(non_decreasing_measure) else true](c,measure(x)+1).first L3

contract.guarantees: Finite, unfolded public operations and exact kernel costs.

story.design_text: comb @until[step: A -> A, measure: A -> Nat](x: A) -> A = let c=Pair<x,step(x)> in @jump[lambda pair -> Pair<pair.second,step(pair.second)>,lambda pair -> if eq(pair.first,pair.second) then false else if le(measure(pair.first),measure(pair.second)) then Bottom(non_decreasing_measure) else true](c,measure(x)+1).first L3

story.name: closure
story.title: Closure
story.definition: Measured kernel control over fixed public operations.
story.design_decl: comb @closure[neighbors: Plan * Nat -> Set<Nat>](p: Plan, seeds: Set<Nat>, universe: Set<Nat> = all_vertices(p)) -> Set<Nat> = @until[lambda seen -> union(seen,intersect(universe,@fold[union](Set<>,@map[neighbors](p,ascending(seen))))),lambda seen -> popcount(difference(universe,seen))](seeds) L4
story.decl: comb @closure[neighbors: A -> A](p: A, seeds: A) -> A = let universe = all_vertices(p) in if eq(difference(seeds, universe), 0) then rec public_spread(seen) = let next = rec public_visit(rest, found) = if empty(rest) then found else public_visit(tail(rest), union(found, neighbors(p, head(rest)))) measure length(rest) in public_visit(ascending(seen), seen) in let inside = intersect(next, universe) in if eq(seen, inside) then seen else public_spread(inside) measure popcount(difference(universe, seen)) in public_spread(seeds) else outside_universe() L4

contract.guarantees: Finite, unfolded public operations and exact kernel costs.

story.design_text: comb @closure[neighbors: Plan * Nat -> Set<Nat>](p: Plan, seeds: Set<Nat>, universe: Set<Nat> = all_vertices(p)) -> Set<Nat> = @until[lambda seen -> union(seen,intersect(universe,@fold[union](Set<>,@map[neighbors](p,ascending(seen))))),lambda seen -> popcount(difference(universe,seen))](seeds) L4
story.ascii: comb @closure[neighbors: A -> A](p: A, seeds: A) -> A = let universe = all_vertices(p) in if eq(difference(seeds, universe), 0) then rec public_spread(seen) = let next = rec public_visit(rest, found) = if empty(rest) then found else public_visit(tail(rest), union(found, neighbors(p, head(rest)))) measure length(rest) in public_visit(ascending(seen), seen) in let inside = intersect(next, universe) in if eq(seen, inside) then seen else public_spread(inside) measure popcount(difference(universe, seen)) in public_spread(seeds) else outside_universe() L4

story.name: divide
story.title: Divide
story.definition: Measured kernel control over fixed public operations.
story.design_decl: comb @divide[leaf: A -> B, merge: B * B -> B](xs: List<A>, zero: B) -> B = if empty(xs) then zero else if singleton(xs) then leaf(head(xs)) else let halves=split_mid(xs) in merge(@divide[leaf,merge](halves.first,zero),@divide[leaf,merge](halves.second,zero)) L5
story.decl: comb @divide[leaf: A -> A, merge: A -> A](xs: A, zero: A) -> A = rec split(items) = if empty(items) then zero else (if singleton_list(items) then leaf(head(items)) else let halves = split_mid(items) in merge(split(first(halves)), split(second(halves)))) measure length(items) in split(xs) L5

contract.guarantees: Finite, unfolded public operations and exact kernel costs.

story.design_text: comb @divide[leaf: A -> B, merge: B * B -> B](xs: List<A>, zero: B) -> B = if empty(xs) then zero else if singleton(xs) then leaf(head(xs)) else let halves=split_mid(xs) in merge(@divide[leaf,merge](halves.first,zero),@divide[leaf,merge](halves.second,zero)) L5

story.name: components
story.title: Components
story.definition: Measured kernel control over fixed public operations.
story.design_decl: comb @components[neighbors: Plan * Nat -> Set<Nat>](p: Plan, universe: Set<Nat> = all_vertices(p)) -> List<Set<Nat>> = @fold[lambda groups,g -> if member(g,groups) then groups else append(groups,g)](List<>,@divide[lambda v -> List<@closure[neighbors](p,Set<v>,universe)>,concat](ascending(universe),List<>)) L6
story.decl: comb @components[neighbors: A -> A](p: A) -> A = rec collect(remaining, groups) = if eq(remaining, 0) then groups else let group = @closure[$neighbors](p, singleton(lowest(remaining))) in collect(difference(remaining, group), append(groups, group)) measure popcount(remaining) in collect(all_vertices(p), List<>) L6

contract.guarantees: Finite, unfolded public operations and exact kernel costs.

story.design_text: comb @components[neighbors: Plan * Nat -> Set<Nat>](p: Plan, universe: Set<Nat> = all_vertices(p)) -> List<Set<Nat>> = @fold[lambda groups,g -> if member(g,groups) then groups else append(groups,g)](List<>,@divide[lambda v -> List<@closure[neighbors](p,Set<v>,universe)>,concat](ascending(universe),List<>)) L6

story.name: branch
story.title: Branch
story.definition: Measured kernel control over fixed public operations.
story.design_decl: comb @branch[rank: Plan * Set<Nat> * Nat -> Tuple<Nat,Nat,Int>](s: State) -> Pair<State,State> = let v = @fold[lambda best,v -> if eq(best,none) or lt(rank(s.plan,?available{s},best),rank(s.plan,?available{s},v)) then v else best](none,ascending(?available{s})) in Pair<take(s,v),ban(s,v)> L7
story.decl: comb @branch[rank: A -> A](s: A) -> A = if eq(?available{s}, 0) then empty_frontier() else let picked = rec pick(rest, best) = if empty(rest) then best else let candidate = head(rest) in pick(tail(rest), if lt(rank(plan(s), ?available{s}, best), rank(plan(s), ?available{s}, candidate)) then candidate else best) measure length(rest) in pick(tail(ascending(?available{s})), head(ascending(?available{s}))) in pair(take(s, picked), ban(s, picked)) L7
